Total body mass by species (50 rows used):

| Species | Total body mass (g) |
|---|---|
| Adelie | 77,000 |
| Gentoo | 77,600 |
| Chinstrap | 53,225 |

**Problems found & fixed:**
- **3 out-of-range body masses** (rows 22, 28, 49: values 5,050,000 / 5,050,000 / 4,050,000 g) violated the rules-file range of 2,500–6,500 g — likely unit or decimal errors. Excluded rather than guessed at a correction.
- Species labels were clean (3 allowed values, no variants); no missing body mass, no duplicate rows.

**Caveats:** The excluded rows may have been recoverable (e.g. 5050 g) if the original source confirms the error — totals would change slightly if reinstated. Other columns (flipper_length_mm has 3 negative values, sex has whitespace variants) were not used in this question and were left untouched.
